fields.text: Prototype a short spoken introduction with a memorable fictional presenter. Muse paints the portrait, MiniMax Speech reads the script, and LongCat animates speech at 480p. Keep scripts under 30 seconds. Cost depends on audio length: video $0.03/second, plus image and speech. Inspect lip sync and pronunciation. The sample uses a male presenter to match the selected male voice. Allow several minutes for lipsync generation.

A fictional motorcycle courier night dispatcher, late 20s, charcoal courier jacket with a single electric-cyan lightning-chevron accent, calm almost-smile, short dark hair, light stubble. Shoulders-up, front-facing talking-head portrait, unobstructed face and mouth, eyes toward camera. Cool night key: magenta rim plus cyan bounce on a charcoal void. No helmet, glasses, hats, readable logos or letters.
This is Volt — pocket night-ride radio for couriers. Dispatch in one ear, city in the other. Stay on channel till the last drop.
Natural calm delivery, subtle blinks and small head movements. Keep the face and mouth visible, eyes toward the camera, body position stable. Locked camera, no cuts or extra people.
